articles.t: With GTA 6 map again set in U.S., Rockstar addresses whether GTA 7 will go international
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 map reintroduces Vice City, after earlier entries took place in U.S. locations like Liberty City. In an interview, the Rockstar North co-lead addressed whether GTA 7 players may visit a new country. Rob Nelson believes fans have still only seen a small portion of a diverse America.
articles.txt:
While the massive GTA 6 map includes multiple regions of Leonida , Vice City is familiar to players. A satirical version of Florida, it’s another Rockstar title set in the United States. Recent hints suggest that the GTA 7 release date could arrive sooner than expected. In a Guardian interview (paywalled), co-studio head Rob Nelson discussed a potential international setting .
The Miami-inspired metropolis has appeared in two previous Grand Theft Auto projects, most notably the 2002 GTA: Vice City . Yet the size of the GTA 6 map introduces countless overlooked areas. Rockstar North 's Rob Nelson explained how dedicated the team was to capturing these locations.
Research involved “staying out in a Miami nightclub until 4 am,” then visiting a racetrack hours later while inebriated. The developers also joined police officers for shifts and scouted eccentric bars in the Florida Keys. Regardless, The Guardian wondered if a different nation would pose a welcome challenge.
Nelson replied, “Never say never, but there’s still so much to do in America,” when asked whether GTA 7 or a future title would leave the U.S. The Scotland-based Rockstar North may be more fascinated with the setting than local players. Even so, since the GTA 6 map shows another side of the country, Nelson argues, “I think we’re all outsiders to this version of America.”
On the November 19th GTA 6 release date , gamers can navigate a Leonida that’s much larger than the open world of GTA 5 or Red Dead Redemption 2 . Still, a leak from 2018 claimed the latest entry originally involved parts of South America. Rockstar verified the Project Americas report and revealed stretched resources led to a downsized vision.
The studio may not face the same limitations when creating the inevitable GTA 7 . In a Bloomberg interview, Technical Director Phil Hooker said the engine designed for GTA 6 can be used in upcoming projects. That could offset the difficulties of researching and rendering a foreign country. Nevertheless, Nelson seems eager to explore a new United States city .

articles.t: Une supercar de GTA 6 mise en vente pour £1 millions
articles.chapeau: Le grand magasin londonien Selfridges met en vente une réplique à taille réelle de la supercar Grotti Cheetah de Grand Theft Auto VI pour £1 millions (≈ $1,33 millions).
articles.txt:
MobiDevices.com Actualités Une supercar de GTA 6 mise en vente pour £1 millions 11.11.2026 à 22:24 Une supercar de GTA 6 mise en vente pour £1 millions Vadim Zaretskiy 2 min Audio 6 Suivre MobiDevices Ajoutez sur Google Source préférée Le grand magasin londonien Selfridges met en vente une réplique à taille réelle de la supercar Grotti Cheetah de Grand Theft Auto VI pour £1 millions (≈ $1,33 millions). La voiture est en état de marche. Elle a été construite par l’atelier West Coast Customs en collaboration avec Rockstar Games.
La carrosserie rappelle la Ferrari Testarossa, tandis que la peinture aux couleurs de Vice City passe du bleu à l’avant au rose à l’arrière. L’atelier a rabaissé la suspension, monté des pneus de piste et garni l’habitacle de cuir italien.
Hypebeast décrit la voiture comme une sportive à moteur central et indique qu’elle est équipée d’un V8 atmosphérique de 4,9 litres. Selfridges ne précise pas quel modèle a servi de base ni quel moteur équipe l’exemplaire exposé.
La Grotti Cheetah est l’une des six voitures de GTA 6 recréées pour un tournage publicitaire dans les rues de Miami. Elle est désormais visible au Selfridges de Londres, sur Oxford Street, où se tient du 9 au 28 novembre l’exposition The Corner Shop, inspirée de Vice City. Pour l’acheter, il faut contacter le service Personal Shopping de Selfridges.
Dans le jeu, la ’95 Grotti Cheetah fait partie des bonus de l’Ultimate Edition. GTA 6 sortira le 19 novembre 2026 sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S.

By Shaheer Khan Published Nov 11, 2026, 2:00 PM EST Ever since a kid, Shaheer has always been intrigued by tech and how its components work, and has always geeked out over new PC component releases. His enthusiasm for tech, gaming, and composing eventually led him to become a writer, a career path he hadn’t quite planned or thought of, but it proved to be a natural fit. Nevertheless, Shaheer has been writing for more than 4 years, having penned more than 2000 articles now across multiple accredited publications. Shaheer mostly covers PC components, including in-depth coverage of each component, but his speciality subsumes within hardware of all sorts. Sign in to your MakeUseOf account The big moment is finally here, and GTA 6 is releasing in a few days . Unfortunately, PC gamers will have to wait a while longer to experience Rockstar's seminal work after already waiting more than a decade.
But the pull of GTA 6 is so strong that PC gamers are going out of their way to buy consoles specifically for the game. Deciding which console to buy might be tricky, as the console space is vastly different from when this generation launched nearly six years ago.
Most people are looking for a PS5 to play GTA 6, but there's a much better, overlooked option that offers better value for money: It's the Xbox Series X.
Xbox Series X console Credit: Shutterstock Credit: Shutterstock With the latest generation of consoles, Microsoft managed to get the upper hand over the PS5 with the Xbox Series X in terms of performance. Here's how their specs compare on paper.
Though the Xbox Series X and the PS5 largely use the same CPU and GPU architecture, the Xbox Series X has higher CPU clocks, more GPU compute units, and more TFLOPS.
Memory bandwidth also shifts the complexity trade-off, since the Xbox Series X divides it into pools for the GPU and the rest for the system, unlike the PS5, which uses a single pool. However, the PS5 has a faster SSD than the Xbox Series X because Microsoft's console is limited to 2 PCIe 4.0 lanes, compared with the PS5's 4.
Xbox app on PC and the Xbox Elite Series 2 controller. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO Xbox app running on Windows 11, and showing the Game Pass catalog. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO The Xbox Elite Series 2 controller on a desk. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO The auxiliary ports on the Xbox Elite Series 2 controller. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO GTA 6 Credit: Rockstar Close Xbox app on PC and the Xbox Elite Series 2 controller. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO The auxiliary ports on the Xbox Elite Series 2 controller. Credit: Suman Biswas/MUO GTA 6 Credit: Rockstar For those who missed it, FSR 4.1 is giving the Xbox Series consoles a second wind with a massive performance boost near the end of its lifecycle. It is officially supported on the Radeon 9000 series, but thanks to a leaked INT8 file, it can be modded onto older RDNA 3 GPUs as well.
Now, AMD and Microsoft are bringing the same technology to the Xbox Series X in two models: FSR 4.1 Light and FSR 4.1 (full model). With this ML-based upscaling, these consoles can free up GPU resources by upscaling images from a lower resolution to a higher one, maintaining most of the quality with better reconstruction.
That said, FSR 4.1 for Xbox Series consoles hasn't been released yet, and it won't be implemented across the entire library, but we can expect it in upcoming releases, particularly GTA 6. FSR 4.1 is a direct contender to DLSS 4 and is better on paper than PS5's QSSR and closer to PS5 Pro's PSSR, since the underlying technology is the same but is tailor-made for each console.
In a benchmark (via Generacion Xbox ), the Xbox Series X had nearly 60% faster AI upscaling than the PS5 with PSSR, with significantly better frame times: 2.75 ms with FSR 4.1, in contrast to the PS5's 4.4ms with the QSSR implementation.
Most likely, FSR 4.1 won't be available for GTA 6 at launch since the tech hasn't debuted on Xbox consoles yet. A post-launch update could bring a performance mode for the Xbox Series X, potentially featuring a 40 FPS mode, with visual trade-offs, of course.

articles.t: Downloading GTA 6? Apparently, it will take some players years – and the community is having a blast!
articles.chapeau: While others are downloading GTA 6 in less than an hour during the preload period, some Reddit users seem to be stuck with internet speeds straight out of the PlayStation 2 era. It's a new running joke in the GTA 6 Reddit community – and probably not meant to be taken too seriously.
articles.txt:
The hype surrounding GTA 6 is reaching new heights. Preloading for Rockstar's game began yesterday, November 10. But while most players are getting ready for release, one fan apparently has a very different problem: Their download seems to be taking longer than Rockstar took to develop the game. The community is having plenty of fun with it.
On Reddit, user Suitable-Ad3971 posted a screenshot of their download progress and dryly commented: "I should have pre-loaded last year..." Another user managed to top that with an estimated remaining download time of 47 years. While some players need just 25 to 30 minutes to download the game, which weighs in at over 200 GB, others apparently have a much longer wait ahead of them.
"Maybe you should learn to code and develop GTA 6 yourself," one user suggested. Another jokingly pointed out that the original developer had taken 13 years, after all. Other suggestions included taking the PlayStation to McDonald's to download the game there, or asking a friend to download it and send the files via email. Whether the download will finish before GTA 7 comes out remains to be seen. Some older users were reminded of the Napster days, when they would leave their PCs running for days just to download a three-minute song over a dial-up connection.
ⓘ Reddit Whether the screenshot is genuine or not, the community has found itself a new running joke. And if the download really is that slow, perhaps the player should consider pre-ordering GTA 7 already. You never know how long that might take.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' Fans Divided as Rockstar Confirms Disappointing PS5 Performance Limit
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 is almost here, but some players are reconsidering their preorders.
articles.txt:
By Pamela Gores Published Nov 11, 2026, 1:48 PM EST Pamela Gores is a Senior News Editor at MovieWeb, where she helps shape daily coverage of film, television, and entertainment news while mentoring writers and contributing to the development of the news team.
Before joining MovieWeb, Pamela spent more than six years at The Direct, where she served as Managing Editor of Copy. During her time there, she covered major conventions, including MEGACON Orlando, and conducted press coverage for Universal Orlando Resort. She has also participated in press junkets for major Marvel Studios productions, including What If...? and She-Hulk: Attorney at Law .
After over a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) is finally approaching its release, but one of the biggest questions surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster has received an answer that isn't sitting well with everyone. While the game promises a massive open world and some of the franchise's most ambitious visuals yet, players hoping for smoother performance on PlayStation consoles face a major compromise.
With the game's Nov. 19 launch just days away, Rockstar shared its performance target across consoles, sparking a debate over whether visual fidelity is worth the expense of frame rate. The announcement is frustrating for PlayStation 5 Pro owners, many of whom expected the upgraded hardware to deliver a more noticeable performance advantage over the standard PS5.
Rockstar Games confirmed that GTA 6 will target 30 frames per second (fps) across all consoles, including the PS5 Pro, as reported by IGN . While this limitation may have been expected given the game's scale, some players are verbally disappointed that the PS5 Pro won't provide a higher frame rate. The more powerful console will still include visual enhancements, including ray-traced shadows and PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), but those improvements won't guarantee the smoother gameplay some buyers had anticipated.
The announcement has divided players across social media. @ExoGhost posted a clip online of them playing GTA 5, noting, "I tried playing GTA 5 at 30 FPS It looks absolutely disgusting. I will not be playing GTA 6 if it's like this." Meanwhile, @Keemotionx defended the 30 fps performance, writing, "Like do you really want a want a watered down version of GTA 6 with nothing to do just to get 60? Me personally, and I think I’d speak for majority of real gamers, we’d rather 30 how it is now with a living breathing world."
Close Jason and Lucia robbing a bank in GTA 6. Rockstar Games A sunset in GTA 6. Rockstar Games A bar filled with people in GTA 6. Rockstar Games Vice City in GTA 6. Rockstar Games The decision becomes more understandable when considering the scale of GTA 6 . The game takes players to Leonida, a fictional state inspired by Florida, featuring the return of well-known Vice City locales such as the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, and Mount Kalaga. Rather than focusing on a single metropolitan area, Rockstar is letting players explore a world that spans cities, coastal communities, and natural environments.
Protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two criminals involved in a statewide conspiracy after a robbery goes wrong, live in an environment designed to feel increasingly alive. In an official announcement , Rockstar explained that the game was developed to push current-generation consoles to their limits while maintaining the visual detail and density of Leonida. This helps explain why the studio has prioritized a consistent 30 fps target over a higher-frame-rate mode.

articles.t: What If GTA 6 Makes You Forget What Mission You Were On?
articles.chapeau: Any open-world game is going to be judged on what it lets you get up to when you’re hell-bent on ignoring its campaign, and based on Rockstar's history and official previews, we think GTA 6 might score quite high in that area.
articles.txt:
I t’s always nice to have a break when you just take some time to yourself despite a long list of tasks to do. That’s equally true of open-world games as it is in real life, and with the year’s biggest one now merely days away from its long-awaited release, we’ve been quite curious about what GTA 6 could feel like when we decide to just engage with Leonida while our to-do list takes a back seat.
We’re thinking about what it’s going to feel like when we engage with Rockstar’s latest game without an agenda or an objective, letting the world just draw us into whatever it has in store for us. Can GTA 6 give us evenings spent doing nothing in its world that still have us coming away with many fond memories?
Judging by what Rockstar has revealed, we think the groundwork’s all there. Here’s why.
And oh, before we move ahead, this feature draws on published previews, interviews, and official footage to explore how the game’s systems could come together. We’ve also included a few hypothetical scenarios and wishlist ideas, so keep in mind that those are speculation rather than confirmed features.
Let’s take a hypothetical scenario: how you will likely begin a new day in Leonida, which is important because official information about the game showcases the potential for simply lazing around at home. You could enjoy a cup of coffee that you’ve made from scratch, and then simply hang around and see what your partner in crime is up to if you’re not inclined to step out of the house.
The act itself seems simple enough, but we’re thinking about the potential to set up a routine, and how that can make our safe houses feel like a space that’s actually lived in. If things are detailed enough, the scope to spend an entire day just observing whatever the other person gets up to can be an interesting way to spend your time in Leonida while whatever the campaign wants you to do stays in the background.
It’s a sign that this is a world where taking your time to savor its minute details is encouraged, and that’s something we’ve all seen Rockstar pull off with style in the past. When you think about the sheer scale and ambition of its latest flagship, it’s hard not to see ourselves choosing to just enjoy every interaction instead of seeing it as something to optimize.
Of course, we can’t stay at home forever, lest we run the risk of what’s happening outside our safe spaces passing us by. Leonida’s crowded beaches from the very first trailer immediately come to mind, as do its street gatherings and the increased amount of NPC interactions that the game is bringing.
The range and scale are already evident, with people sporting varied appearances and gestures, and a variety of ways they can respond to your presence in any given place. Rob Nelson’s guided preview of the game from a short while ago to EDGE highlighted an NPC taking offense at Jason staring at him for too long. We wonder how many other such interactions could unfold as we free roam around Leonida, and about all the hours we could spend just trying to uncover as many as we can.
Of course, that isn’t the extent of how the open world could encourage ignoring what you have to do to indulge in stuff you want to do.
The game’s approach to the radio is another facet of the experience we’d like to call attention to thanks to reports of some very popular names at the helm of the many radio stations we can tune into, not just from our car, like in GTA 6’s predecessor, but via our phones if we decide to take a walk through a new neighborhood.
We’re not sure about you, but many of us are the kind of listener who’s more than happy to just find a nearby bench and engage with a new song or podcast until it’s complete. Given that it’s something we do so often in our daily lives, combined with Rockstar’s penchant for great playlists and a whole lot of punch, simply turning on the radio could mean hours spent just vibing to whatever beats are being broadcast over the airwaves.
It’s an excuse to take the long way around when you’re trying to get to a mission, and with the game’s penchant for unscripted events factored in, forgetting what you meant to do seems like it could be a lot more organic than it was in the past – a hallmark of an open world that truly lets you loose to wander its bounds without a goal in mind.

articles.t: GTA 6 Surpasses $1 Billion in Presales a Week Before Launch
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 has reportedly surpassed $1 billion in pre-sales, with 10.31 million copies sold ahead of launch and projections reaching $5 billion.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6) has reportedly surpassed $1 billion in pre-launch revenue, with more than 10 million copies sold ahead of its highly anticipated release.
According to new data from analytics firm Sensor Tower , Rockstar Games’ upcoming open-world game has generated more than $1 billion in pre-sales, with an estimated 10.31 million copies sold. The milestone comes roughly a week before the game is scheduled to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.
The latest figures represent a significant jump from where GTA 6 stood just last week. On November 3, Sensor Tower estimated that the game had generated more than $750 million in pre-sales, with approximately 7.71 million copies sold across PlayStation and Xbox consoles.
That means GTA 6 has added more than 2.6 million copies sold and roughly $250 million in revenue in just over seven days, highlighting the extraordinary demand surrounding Rockstar’s next major release.
Even compared to just a day ago , sales have jumped around $60 million.
The numbers are particularly impressive when compared to the launch of Grand Theft Auto 5. When it arrived in September 2013, the previous entry generated more than $800 million in worldwide sales during its first 24 hours. It then surpassed $1 billion in just three days, becoming the fastest entertainment property to reach that milestone at the time.
GTA 6 is already estimated to have generated that much in revenue before its release.
While surpassing $1 billion in presales is an impressive milestone, some industry projections suggest the game’s launch could be on an entirely different scale.
A July 2026 analysis from market research firm Newzoo estimated that GTA 6 could generate between $3.3 billion and $5.2 billion in cumulative global sales by the end of its first week.
The projection was based on early pre-order performance across major markets and historical sales patterns for successful sequels. Newzoo estimated that the game could generate approximately $260 million in its opening week across the markets it analyzed, with its global sales projection accounting for the expected ramp-up in spending.
For comparison, GTA 5 generated more than $1 billion in its first three days on the market. A potential $5 billion opening week for its successor would represent an extraordinary jump, even for one of the biggest entertainment franchises in history.
It’s worth noting that Sensor Tower’s pre-sales figures are estimates rather than official sales numbers from Rockstar or parent company Take-Two Interactive. The same applies to Newzoo’s launch projections, which are forecasts rather than guaranteed results.
Nevertheless, with more than 10 million estimated pre-sales already on the books, GTA 6 is heading toward a launch that could potentially rewrite the record books.
Are you surprised by the early sales of GTA 6? Let us know down in the comments and in the official Insider Gaming Discord .

articles.t: Taking Off Work or Skipping School to Play GTA 6? So Are 12.5 Million Other People
GTA 6’s 212 GB Preload Caused Yorkshire Congestion and Set Virgin Media O2 Records
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's 212 GB preload congested YouFibre's Yorkshire gateway and broke Virgin Media O2 traffic records before the game even launched.
articles.txt:
Image: PlayStation One game's preload created a gateway capacity problem for a regional UK provider and drove all-time traffic records at a second, showing how blockbuster releases now place real pressure on consumer internet infrastructure.
Customers around Yorkshire noticed slower speeds well before GTA 6's November 19 release date. YouFibre CEO Jeremy Chelot attributed the disruption to GTA 6 downloads in a post on X, stating that traffic had caused an issue with one of the company's broadband network gateways.
GTA6 is causing issue with one of our BNG…trying to rebalance the traffic therefore people around Yorkshire are currently suffering congestion…bear with us please.
Engineers rebalanced traffic across YouFibre's wider network to restore normal service. Customers actively downloading the game continued to experience reduced speeds during recovery, as those downloads were being prioritized while engineers stabilized the gateway.
At up to 212 GB depending on the device , GTA 6's preload is unusually large by modern standards.
That size concentrated an enormous volume of demand into a narrow time window. Preloading opened well before the November 19 release on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, compressing download activity rather than spreading it across a launch day. Researchers exploring internet speed advances have highlighted just how strained existing ISP capacity limits can become under heavy data demand.
Within one hour of preload activation, traffic on Virgin Media O2's network rose more than 50 percent above the prior week's comparable figure.
Virgin Media O2 reported its largest-ever traffic peak and highest-ever daily data volume, both tied to the GTA 6 preload. Traffic climbed 51.6 percent compared with the same period the previous week within an hour of preloading going live.
By 9 a.m. on the day preloading opened, total data downloaded across Virgin Media O2's network was 73.3 percent higher than the prior week's figure. The company did not report a service outage, distinguishing its experience from the gateway incident at YouFibre.
YouFibre's congestion incident was regional, affecting customers around Yorkshire and resolved through traffic management. Virgin Media O2's figures describe an unprecedented volume of data for that provider, not a network failure.
No available reporting establishes that GTA 6 preloading caused a nationwide UK internet outage.
Because a preload concentrates downloads into hours rather than days, ISPs can face demand spikes with little time to prepare.
The GTA 6 preload produced documented effects at two separate UK providers simultaneously. One experienced gateway congestion severe enough to require emergency traffic rebalancing; the other logged the highest data volumes in its history.
Both outcomes point in the same direction. Large game releases are no longer contained events for gaming networks alone; they produce measurable pressure on the broader broadband infrastructure that everyday customers rely on.

articles.t: ‘Play is not the opposite of work’: Logitech is giving workers time off for GTA 6 | VGC
articles.chapeau: Logitech says that its workers can take a day off for GTA 6, or another new game…
articles.txt:
Logitech says that it will allow its workers to take a day off to play a new game of their choice.
This new policy has been rolled out just ahead of Grand Theft Auto 6 ‘s release, which is expected to result in a significant number of workers taking the day off across various industries.
While some analysts worry about the effect this will have on the economy, Logitech appears to be embracing it, giving workers an additional day of holiday to use for gaming.
“It’s time to retire the stereotype that gaming is a waste of time,” Logitech CEO Hanneke Faber told Fortune . “As a company designing products for work and play, we see every day how engagement in one sphere supports performance in the other.”
Others at Logitech agree. “Play is not the opposite of work,” said chief people officer Elaine Laird. “When people have dedicated time to log off, decompress and immerse themselves in play, they return with clearer focus, renewed energy and fresh approaches to complex challenges.”
While the day can be used for any game, Logitech has indicated that it is fine with the bulk of the workforce taking November 19 off for GTA 6, saying: “If employees choose to spend their Gaming Time Off exploring Vice City on launch day, you won’t hear any complaints from us.”
Of course, playing GTA 6 for a day may only be enough for players to scratch the surface of what the game has to offer, and some workers may be hoping to get more time off to play the first new Grand Theft Auto in 13 years.
It remains to be seen if any other gaming-adjacent companies roll out similar policies. No doubt, they are bracing for a quieter day in the office come November 19.

articles.t: GTA 6 file size and download times: how long will it take?
articles.chapeau: See how long it’ll take to download at your broadband speed, and read our tips on how to download it as quickly as possible before launch on 19 November.
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on Thursday 19 November, and according to Uswitch research, around 2.8 million UK adults plan to play it on launch day¹, with an extra 10 million or so intending to play it at some point after launch.
However, as it’s the first flagship Rockstar video game to launch as a download-only release, these millions of players will need to ensure their broadband is up to scratch in order to play it – especially as it’s one of the largest video games ever to launch, in terms of file size.
Our recent survey showed that 33% of working people who plan to play GTA 6 expect to have issues downloading the game², as a file this size could take several hours, even days, to download on a slow or inconsistent internet connection. But there are ways you can ensure the smoothest download possible.
Here’s everything you need to do with your internet to ensure you can download it with ease and play it as soon as possible on launch day.
As of Tuesday 10 November, GTA 6 became available to preload onto your console. As it’s such a large game, this is the only way to guarantee you’ll be able to play it on launch day. And since downloading it could take some time, this means you can have it ready well in advance of launch day and start playing as soon as it’s unlocked.
Rockstar has officially confirmed that GTA 6 is around 212GB . This is a far cry from some of the early rumours of a 700GB+ game, but it’s still right at the top end of mainstream video games, and larger than Rockstar’s legendary Red Dead Redemption 2.
How long Grand Theft Auto VI will take to download mostly depends on four things:
Here's how long it could take you to download GTA 6 depending on the broadband speed you pay for.
Note: This guide assumes an uninterrupted download speed. Realistically, your broadband speed will fluctuate and/or be affected by other connected devices at home.
Measure your current internet speed and see how it compares to other broadband deals available in your area.
Could you upgrade your broadband? If you’re still on a part-fibre, part-copper connection, you might be able to significantly improve your internet connection by moving to full fibre. It’s a huge upgrade to your home broadband as it provides a much faster, much more consistent internet connection, and crucially, it’s often cheaper per month than existing part-fibre deals.
Full fibre is now available to over 80% of UK homes, and its coverage only continues to grow. So you could very likely see a range of providers offering this more advanced connection if you check your address. Thanks to rules like One Touch Switch , switching broadband is very simple, and only requires you to sign up with your new provider – there’s no need to cancel your old contract yourself.
Once done, future large file downloads will likely be far less frustrating, and GTA 6 Online will run a lot more smoothly once it’s released.
Compare full fibre broadband in your area with our FTTP broadband checker.
How to download GTA 6 as quickly as possible Regardless of your official broadband speed, there are ways you can optimise your internet connection at home to ensure a speedy download of GTA 6’s mammoth 212GB file.
You won’t get very far downloading GTA 6 if your storage space is nearly full. Offload games (or additional DLC of games) you don’t play and auto-saved media your console has captured over time to free up the required space to download GTA 6.
A wired connection between your console and your Wi-Fi router is the most trustworthy way to get a strong, consistent download speed. Many gamers have a spare Ethernet cable lying around, so if you already have one, downloading the game will be much easier.
If you need to download wirelessly, you need your Wi-Fi signal to be as strong as possible. Use the 5GHz band if it’s available and make sure your router is out in the open, unobstructed by other objects like cabinets or TVs. Also, try to move your console as close to it as possible to reduce any chance of the signal being blocked by internal walls.

Logitech Is Giving 7,000 Employees a Day Off to Play GTA 6
articles.chapeau: Logitech is giving all 7,000 employees, including interns, one paid day off to play any video game, timed to the GTA VI launch window.
articles.txt:
Image: Logitech Roughly 7,000 Logitech employees now have a dedicated day off to play a video game of their choice. The company calls the initiative "Logi Game Day," and workers can use it at any point during the year following the announcement.
Logitech scheduled a San Jose gaming event for November 19, 2026, the date associated with Grand Theft Auto VI's planned launch, though the employee benefit itself is not tied to that release.
The company timed its announcement around the anticipated November 19, 2026 release of Grand Theft Auto VI. Logitech also scheduled a gaming livestream at its Americas headquarters in San Jose for that date, hosted by Robin Piispanen, Logitech G's general manager and a former competitive gamer.
Attendance at the San Jose event was limited. The employee benefit is not tied to GTA VI or any specific title; workers may use the day for any game they choose.
The November date gives the initiative an obvious marketing dimension. By aligning the announcement with one of gaming's highest-profile release windows, Logitech ensures the program receives attention at a moment when the broader public is already focused on the medium.
Three executives offered rationales for the initiative, all of which should be read as company claims rather than independently established findings.
CEO Hanneke Faber positioned the program as a challenge to the assumption that gaming and workplace productivity sit in opposition. For a company whose products span office peripherals and gaming hardware, she argued, the two naturally reinforce each other.
Chief people officer Elaine Laird framed the day as structured recovery time. Her view is that employees who disconnect and immerse themselves in play will return with clearer focus and renewed energy.
Piispanen added that cooperative and competitive gaming may support teamwork and problem-solving on the job. Each of these statements represents Logitech's organizational rationale, attributed to named executives.
Logitech cited two surveys to support its productivity argument, but both measure belief and perception rather than observed output.
Eighty-one percent of surveyed gamers reported that gaming builds real-world confidence and reduces anxiety. That same group said gaming correlates with stronger day-to-day work performance, according to figures Logitech cited. A separate study, conducted with 600 enterprise IT decision-makers, found that 98.8% believed gaming translates into workplace skills such as complex problem-solving and performing under pressure.
Both findings capture what respondents believe, not what controlled research has measured. Neither establishes a causal link between gaming and productivity output.
Logi Game Day functions as both an employee benefit and a calculated piece of employer branding, and the two purposes are not in conflict.
The benefit is genuine: it is flexible in timing, open to any game, and available to full-time staff and interns alike. It is also a brand-alignment move that connects Logitech's internal culture to its consumer-facing gaming identity.
Whether a single gaming day shifts how employees feel about their employer remains an open question. The initiative does, at minimum, signal clearly where Logitech sees itself within the broader culture of gaming.

articles.t: Sony dépasse les 100 millions de PS5 vendues, alors que les achats reculent avant GTA VI
articles.chapeau: La PS5 dépasse les 100 millions de ventes en novembre 2026. Mais les volumes chutent de 6,5 à 4,2 millions sur six mois, avant le lancement très attendu de GTA VI.
articles.txt:
Le cap symbolique tombe au moment où la dynamique commerciale ralentit. À l’approche du prochain Grand Theft Auto, la machine de Sony affiche un bilan historique solide, sans encore bénéficier du sursaut attendu.
Dans son annonce de novembre 2026, Sony indique avoir vendu plus de 100 millions de PlayStation 5 depuis son lancement, six ans auparavant. La console devient ainsi la quatrième plateforme de la marque à franchir ce seuil.
Ce nouveau seuil prolonge une trajectoire déjà suivie lors du précédent bilan de Sony, quand la PS5 avait dépassé 84,2 millions d’unités avec une dynamique alors plus mesurée.
Le rythme récent est toutefois nettement moins favorable : entre avril et septembre 2026, Sony rapporte 4,2 millions d’unités vendues, contre 6,5 millions sur la même période de 2025. Cela représente une baisse d’environ 35 %, malgré les attentes placées dans le lancement imminent de GTA VI pour stimuler les achats de consoles.
Au classement des plateformes PlayStation, la PS5 reste derrière la première PlayStation et ses 102,4 millions d’exemplaires, la PS4 à 117 millions et la PS2 à plus de 160 millions. La PSP et la PlayStation 3 se situent en dessous de son total actuel.
La carrière commerciale de cette génération n’est cependant pas terminée. Les ventes devraient se poursuivre jusqu’au lancement attendu de la PS6 en 2028, et même au-delà : le classement actuel ne constitue donc pas son bilan définitif.
Sur le logiciel, Sony revendique un cumul de 1,795 milliard de jeux vendus sur PS4 et PS5 . Ce total englobe les éditions physiques, les titres uniquement téléchargeables, les jeux PS VR ainsi que les logiciels fournis dans les packs PS4 et PS5.
PlayStation comptait par ailleurs 127 millions d’utilisateurs actifs mensuels au 30 septembre 2026. Sony ne formule pas de prévision explicite sur leur évolution, mais la sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI pourrait soutenir la fréquentation pendant les fêtes de fin d’année.
Le jeu a déjà battu les records de précommandes sur les boutiques Xbox et PlayStation. La demande liée à GTA VI s’est aussi manifestée sur la PlayStation 5 Pro : de précédentes informations faisaient état de stocks épuisés chez plusieurs revendeurs, puis d’une forte hausse des prix.
Ces tensions sur la Pro ne suffisent pas à établir une reprise pour toute la gamme. Pour Sony, l’enjeu sera de convertir l’attente autour de GTA VI en achats de matériel, et pas seulement en ventes de jeux auprès d’un parc déjà considérable.

GTA 6 : des fichiers manquants dans plusieurs pays font craindre des versions censurées
articles.chapeau: À peine lancé en préchargement, GTA 6 se retrouve au cœur d’un soupçon de censure lié à des fichiers Rest of World manquants. De l’Australie au Japon, les indices techniques s’accumulent et posent une question brûlante pour la version française.
articles.txt:
À peine lancé en préchargement, GTA 6 se retrouve au cœur d’un soupçon de censure lié à des fichiers Rest of World manquants. De l’Australie au Japon, les indices techniques s’accumulent et posent une question brûlante pour la version française.
Le préchargement de GTA 6 vient à peine de démarrer sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S que les dataminers flairent déjà la polémique. En analysant les 212 Go que réclame le futur Grand Theft Auto VI , certains ont repéré des fichiers manquants dans plusieurs pays, dont l’Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande, faisant naître la peur de versions censurées.
Sur X, le dataminer TexFunz2 s’est penché sur la structure PlayGo de la version PS5, découpée en 32 blocs de données. Il a repéré deux fichiers clés, « core_restofworld » (environ 1,5 Go) et « core_restofworld001 » (704 Ko), dont la présence varie selon les régions. De quoi alimenter toutes les théories, notamment sur la censure au Japon et en Océanie.
Selon TexFunz2, « Rest of World regroupe des contenus qui ont été censurés dans certaines versions régionales, probablement la version japonaise dans ce cas ». Les chiffres lui donnent partiellement raison : sur Xbox Series X|S , le build mondial de GTA 6 pèse environ 209,86 Gio, alors que le build japonais descend à 208,74 Gio, soit près de 1,2 Go de données en moins.
Cette différence intrigue d’autant plus que la fiche CERO Z du Japon ne mentionne que violence et crime, quand l’ ESRB , le PEGI et l’ Australian Classification Board listent clairement nudité, drogues et « strong sex scenes ». Combiné à l’historique de versions allégées des jeux Rockstar Games au Japon , beaucoup y voient le signe probable de scènes sexuelles coupées localement.
Sur PlayStation 5 , l’anomalie la plus commentée reste pourtant ailleurs : le petit fichier « core_restofworld001 » est totalement absent du build Australie Nouvelle-Zélande, alors qu’il est présent dans les autres régions. Avec seulement 704 Ko, il ne peut pas contenir une mission complète, mais plutôt une texture sensible, un logo ou un simple fichier de configuration.
Le passé de l’ Australie et de la Nouvelle-Zélande en matière de censure nourrit la suspicion, ces pays ayant déjà forcé des coupes dans GTA III et Vice City , notamment sur les prostituées et la drogue. Pourtant, la fiche officielle classe GTA 6 en R18+ « Original » avec violence forte, nudité et scènes de sexe, ce qui laisse penser que la version soumise n’a pas été édulcorée. Les fichiers restent chiffrés avant la sortie, et Rockstar Games n’a pas confirmé la moindre coupe régionale.
Bonne nouvelle pour les joueurs français : les tableaux de taille et d’identifiant publiés pour Xbox Series X|S montrent que la France utilise le même build mondial que les Etats-Unis, le Royaume-Uni ou l’Allemagne, autour de 209,86 Gio. Ce package inclut bien « core_restofworld » et « core_restofworld001 », sans fichier manquant spécifique à notre région.
Le préchargement ouvert le 10 novembre 2026 en Europe confirme d’ailleurs un gabarit identique entre France et Etats-Unis, tandis que la classification PEGI 18 assume déjà violence extrême, drogues et contenu sexuel explicite. Sauf surprise de dernière minute, les scènes les plus crues devraient donc être identiques chez nous, et les vraies différences se jouer plutôt du côté de la version japonaise.

articles.t: GTA 6 : chez quel opérateur pourrez-vous télécharger plus rapidement le jeu ?
articles.chapeau: Le classement des box en France désigne un vainqueur. Dans la réalité, c'est un peu plus compliqué
articles.txt:
Le classement des box en France désigne un vainqueur. Dans la réalité, c’est un peu plus compliqué
Depuis quelques heures, votre console est sur les starting-blocs. GTA 6 est disponible en pré-chargement, et la machine doit réussir l’exploit d’avaler un fichier deux fois plus lourd que celui du précédent épisode, sans même un disque dans la boîte pour faire illusion. Sur les forums comme sous les vidéos de trailers, une question revient en boucle : chez quel fournisseur d’accès faut-il être pour en voir le bout avant tout le monde ?
Le pré-chargement de GTA 6 a ouvert ce mardi 10 novembre à minuit, heure locale, sur PS5. Sur Xbox Series X, le studio a choisi un créneau mondial unique calé sur minuit GMT, soit 1h du matin en France. Le jeu, lui, se débloquera le 19 novembre à minuit pile. En attendant, les consoles vont tourner à plein régime.
Le poids annoncé atteint 212 Go. Un sacré morceau, d’autant plus que les acheteurs de l’édition physique ne s’en tireront pas mieux : la boîte vendue en magasin à partir du 12 novembre ne contient qu’un code de téléchargement, Rockstar ayant fait le choix de se passer de support physique.
Pour départager les opérateurs, la référence reste le baromètre annuel de nPerf, qui compile des millions de tests. Sa dernière édition, publiée en janvier à partir des mesures de 2025, place Bouygues Telecom en tête du débit descendant avec 491 Mbit/s en moyenne . Free suit à 451 Mbit/s, devant Orange (425 Mbit/s) et SFR (340 Mbit/s). Au classement global, Free glisse à la troisième place à cause de sa latence, un critère qui compte lorsqu’il est question de jeu en ligne, mais pas du tout pour un téléchargement.
Avec ces moyennes et en conditions idéales, les 212 Go descendent en 58 minutes chez Bouygues , 1h03 chez Free, 1h07 chez Orange et 1h23 chez SFR. Entre le premier et le dernier, l’écart reste sous la demi-heure, pour un préchargement ouvert neuf jours avant la sortie. Rien de trop grave donc. On vous déconseille d’ailleurs de changer de box juste pour l’occasion : entre la souscription, le rendez-vous de raccordement et la livraison du matériel, GTA 6 sera sorti depuis longtemps. Quant à la latence, présentée par Bouygues comme un critère « déterminant pour les joueurs en ligne », elle ne servira à rien le 19 novembre : GTA 6 sort avec son seul mode solo. Il faudra attendre pour profiter du mode online.
Le maillon le plus lent n’est presque jamais la fibre. La PS5 et la Xbox Series X disposent toutes deux d’un port Ethernet gigabit, plafonné à 1 000 Mbit/s. Les offres à 5 ou 8 Gbit/s vendues par les opérateurs ne servent donc à rien pour remplir le SSD d’une console. Même branchée en direct sur la box la plus chère du marché, une PS5 mettra environ une demi-heure à récupérer les 212 Go.
En Wi-Fi en revanche, la situation se dégrade vite. La PS5 gère le Wi-Fi 6 jusqu’à 1,2 Gbit/s, quand la Xbox Series X s’arrête au Wi-Fi 5. Dans la vraie vie, un mur porteur, une console coincée dans un meuble fermé ou une connexion restée sur la bande 2,4 GHz suffisent à faire fondre le débit. Autre facteur que personne ne maîtrise, les serveurs. Le soir de l’ouverture, des millions de joueurs se connecteront en même temps, ce qui risque de considérablement ralentir le flux disponible.
Pour gagner du temps, un câble Ethernet entre la console et la box fait la plus grosse différence . Il suffit ensuite d’activer le téléchargement automatique en mode repos sur PS5 (ou en mode démarrage instantané sur Xbox) et de laisser la machine travailler la nuit. Avec neuf jours devant soi, mieux vaut lancer le pré-chargement cette semaine plutôt que le 18 au soir, en même temps que tous les retardataires. Reste à savoir combien pèsera le patch que Rockstar promet déjà de livrer à la sortie du jeu.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Une nouvelle bande-annonce de préchargement semble lancer une pique aux fans critiques
articles.chapeau: Le préchargement de GTA 6 a enfin commencé, et Rockstar a publié une nouvelle bande-annonce courte pour marquer l’occasion. Si ces images offrent peu de matière à spéculer, certains fans pensent que Rockstar cherchait à faire passer un message.
articles.txt:
Les fans peuvent précharger GTA 6 depuis le 10 novembre. Rockstar a également publié une nouvelle bande-annonce pour l'occasion (intégrée ci-dessous), et un passage en particulier a suscité un vif débat. Pour comprendre pourquoi, il vaut la peine de revenir sur l'Extended Look publié fin août. À 17:22 , Jason effectue un salto arrière pour plonger dans l'eau. Cependant, il ne commence sa rotation qu'une fois déjà en l'air. Cela n'a pas beaucoup de sens du point de vue de la physique, et de nombreux spectateurs ont trouvé l'animation peu naturelle. Rockstar a donc essuyé quelques critiques.
La bande-annonce de préchargement de 30 secondes s'ouvre sur une brève scène en boîte de nuit avant de montrer un pilote de course exécutant un salto arrière à la perfection – et c'est sur ce passage que les fans se sont attardés. De nombreux internautes sur Reddit soupçonnent Rockstar d'avoir délibérément inclus cette acrobatie en guise de réponse malicieuse à ceux qui avaient critiqué l'animation de Jason, presque comme pour dire que le studio sait parfaitement animer des mouvements acrobatiques. " Ils savaient EXACTEMENT ce qu'ils faisaient avec ce salto arrière ", peut-on lire dans le commentaire ayant reçu le plus de votes positifs lors d'une récente discussion au sein de la communauté. Impossible de dire si ce salto arrière était réellement destiné à lancer une pique aux détracteurs. C'est néanmoins ainsi que de nombreux fans l'ont interprété.
Il existe également une distinction importante : le salto arrière de Jason dans l'Extended Look semble provenir d'une séquence de gameplay, tandis que l'acrobatie de la bande-annonce de préchargement ressemble davantage à une séquence scriptée. Si Rockstar voulait vraiment faire passer un message, un salto arrière tout aussi convaincant en pleine phase de jeu dans GTA 6 ( disponible en précommande sur Amazon ) serait un argument plus solide.

articles.t: Liberty City dans GTA 6 ? Une nouvelle bande-annonce ravive l’espoir d’une deuxième ville
articles.chapeau: Un petit détail dans la nouvelle bande-annonce de préchargement de GTA 6 a relancé les spéculations sur la présence de lieux supplémentaires dans le jeu. Certains fans espèrent même que Liberty City pourrait faire son apparition en tant que deuxième ville jouable.
articles.txt:
Au premier abord, la nouvelle bande-annonce de préchargement de GTA 6 semblait n'offrir guère plus qu'une possible pique aux fans qui avaient critiqué une précédente animation de salto arrière . Mais un autre détail a désormais attiré l'attention des fans. Cette fois, les regards se portent sur un yacht qui apparaît aux alentours de la dixième seconde . Sur sa poupe, sous le nom "Ships And Giggles", figure le mot "Gloriana".
Cette inscription, à elle seule, ne révèle pas grand-chose. Mais une publication du créateur de contenu TGG , spécialisé dans GTA , a lancé une discussion sur une éventuelle deuxième carte. TGG a partagé une image du yacht sur X, accompagnée d'un vêtement qu'il a décrit comme un "t-shirt Liberty City". Il a également fait remarquer, sur un ton apparemment sarcastique, que ces détails n'étaient sûrement là que pour étoffer l'univers du jeu. Son commentaire semble suggérer que Rockstar pourrait faire allusion à des lieux situés au-delà du cadre connu du jeu.
Ce que TGG pense précisément que l'inscription sur le yacht pourrait révéler reste flou. Certains utilisateurs de X jugent néanmoins plausible l'idée de lieux supplémentaires et supposent que "Gloriana" pourrait désigner un autre État – peut-être une version fictive de la Géorgie imaginée par Rockstar. Le supposé "t-shirt Liberty City" laisse toutefois les fans perplexes, car il ne présente aucun lien évident avec la ville.
Les spéculations vont encore plus loin dans les réponses à la publication de TGG. L'utilisateur de X Blue Thunder affirme être certain à 95% que Liberty City apparaîtra comme deuxième carte dans GTA 6 . Selon sa théorie, la métropole bien connue des joueurs de GTA 4 deviendrait accessible vers le milieu de la campagne. Il n'apporte toutefois aucune preuve concrète à l'appui de cette affirmation.
La théorie a suscité des espoirs sur Reddit , même si elle semble aussi assez tirée par les cheveux. Blue Thunder ne fournit aucune preuve pour étayer sa prédiction, et le chiffre de 95% n’est que son estimation personnelle. On devrait savoir d’ici quelques jours si GTA 6 ( disponible en précommande sur Amazon ) propose réellement des villes ou des États supplémentaires.

articles.t: Un initié explique pourquoi GTA 6 tourne à 30 FPS même sur la Sony PlayStation 5 Pro
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 sortira le 19 novembre sur les consoles Sony PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro et Microsoft Xbox Series X | S. Cependant, Rockstar a annoncé que GTA 6 sera limité à 30 FPS. RedGamingTech, un initié réputé, a tenté d’expliquer la véritable raison de cette limitation à 30 FPS.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 tourne à une cadence verrouillée à 30 FPS, même sur la Sony PlayStation 5 Pro. De nombreux joueurs attribuent ce sacrifice en matière de performances à la décision de Rockstar d’utiliser le ray tracing. RedGamingTech, un initié reconnu qui était auparavant réputé pour ses fuites sur le matériel informatique, explique que si GTA 6 tourne à 30 FPS sur les consoles Sony PS5 et Xbox Series X | S, c’est davantage à cause de la lenteur de leurs processeurs que du ray tracing.
RGT écrit sur X que GTA 6 propose un monde ouvert « absolument IMMENSE », rempli de PNJ et de systèmes qui mettent les processeurs à rude épreuve. Les processeurs des PS5 et Xbox Series doivent gérer « la physique, l’IA, le code général du jeu et, oui, les threads de rendu ». Sachant que les processeurs à 8 cœurs des PS5, PS5 Pro et Xbox Series X | S reposent sur l’architecture vieillissante AMD Zen 2, GTA 6 n’est pas un jeu facile à faire tourner sur les consoles modernes.
Les processeurs peu puissants des consoles sont donc très probablement la principale raison pour laquelle Rockstar a verrouillé GTA 6 à 30 FPS sur consoles. Malheureusement, le jeu à 30 FPS offre un moins bon rendu sur les écrans modernes dont les pixels ont un temps de réponse rapide . Les joueurs qui souhaitent jouer à des fréquences de rafraîchissement plus élevées pour profiter d’images nettes, d’une expérience fluide et d’une faible latence des commandes devront attendre le portage PC de GTA 6 .
La bonne nouvelle, c’est que le portage PC de GTA 6 pourrait arriver plus tôt que prévu. Rockstar craindrait que des moddeurs utilisent l’IA pour porter la version console de GTA 6 sur PC. Cette crainte n’est pas infondée, puisque nous avons vu l’IA donner un formidable coup d’accélérateur à la scène de l’émulation de consoles . Certains ont même utilisé l’IA pour porter des jeux exclusifs à PlayStation sur PC .

articles.t: GTA 6 porté sur PC grâce à l'IA ? Le PDG de Take-Two réagit
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) sortira le 19 novembre sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X/S, mais pas sur PC. Cela étant dit, le jeu de Rockstar Games
articles.txt:
Sony détaille un peu plus la rétrocompatibilité sur sa PlayStation 5. Il sera possible de jouer à la grande majorité des jeux PlayStation 4 sur la PS5, mais tous ne seront pas compatibles.
Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA 6 ) sortira le 19 novembre sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X/S, mais pas sur PC. Cela étant dit, le jeu de Rockstar Games pourrait (plus ou moins) rapidement être disponible officieusement sur PC grâce à la rétro-ingénierie et l’intelligence artificielle. Strauss Zelnick, le PDG de Take-Two, la maison-mère de Rockstar Games, a réagi à ce sujet.
L’intelligence artificielle est de plus en plus douée pour tout ce qui touche le développement et cela se ressent dans le monde du jeu vidéo. Le dernier exemple en date concerne les émulateurs pour la Nintendo Switch 2 . Il en existe plusieurs et la plupart des développeurs se reposent sur l’intelligence artificielle, comme ChatGPT ou Claude, pour justement développer des émulateurs et corriger les bugs.
Il y a également semaines, Grand Theft Auto V ( GTA 5 ) avait même été jouable directement depuis un navigateur . L’auteur n’a jamais détaillé publiquement son processus, mais on peut se douter qu’il s’est appuyé sur l’IA pour réaliser une telle tâche.
Vient maintenant le cas de GTA 6 . Certains espèrent qu’un jailbreak du dernier firmware en date de la PS5 va voir le jour et permettra d’extraire le jeu en version déchiffrée pour ensuite essayer de le porter sur PC de manière officieuse, là encore grâce à l’IA.
Interrogé à ce sujet lors de l’appel téléphonique qui a suivi la publication des résultats financiers du groupe, Strauss Zelnick a déclaré :
Ce secteur a toujours été largement épargné par les problèmes de piratage en raison de la taille des fichiers, de la complexité du piratage, de la nécessité d’être connecté à des serveurs, etc. Et il est indéniable qu’il serait très difficile de reproduire l’expérience de jeu telle qu’elle est prévue en raison de contraintes techniques.
Cela dit, cela va devenir un défi de plus en plus important, comme vous l’avez dit, et nous en sommes conscients. Nous nous concentrons donc pleinement sur le renforcement de nos défenses techniques et sur l’intensification de nos actions juridiques de manière appropriée. Et en même temps, sans pour autant faire preuve de désinvolture, toute entreprise du secteur du divertissement est confrontée, dans une certaine mesure, au piratage. Ce phénomène est donc susceptible d’affecter notre activité à des degrés divers. Je pense que cela restera gérable et nous y consacrons toute notre attention.
Il est certain que porter officieusement GTA 6 sur PC sera loin d’être une simple tâche, même avec l’aide de l’IA. Mais Rockstar Games pourrait limiter la casse, puisqu’une rumeur suggère que la version PC du jeu sortira au premier trimestre de 2027 , soit quelques mois après la version PS5 et Xbox Series X/S. Ce serait nettement plus rapide que pour GTA 5 où les joueurs PC avaient dû attendre 1 an et demi par rapport aux joueurs PlayStation 3 et Xbox 360.
Merci de nous avoir signalé l'erreur, nous allons corriger cela rapidement.

articles.t: GTA 6 : Même Hollywood commence à se préparer pour l'impact que va causer la sortie du jeu
articles.chapeau: Bon nombre de studios n’ont pas voulu se frotter à GTA 6 en cette fin d’année, à tort ou à raison. Le jeu de Rockstar va bel et bien [...]
articles.txt:
Bon nombre de studios n’ont pas voulu se frotter à GTA 6 en cette fin d’année, à tort ou à raison. Le jeu de Rockstar va bel et bien monopoliser l’espace médiatique (c’est déjà le cas), si bien qu’exister à ses côtés durant les prochaines semaines sera compliqué. et cela ne vaut pas que pour l’industrie du jeu vidéo. The Hollywood Reporter a fait le point sur l’impact que pourrait causer la sortie du jeu sur les films et séries à venir, et s’il n’est pas encore tout à fait palpable, une certaine crainte est présente.
GTA 6 n’occulte pas encore les sorties cinéma, mais tout le monde est tendu Pour mesurer les conséquences de la sortie de GTA 6 sur le cinéma et le monde de la télévision (plus précisément du streaming), le site est allé questionner Bart Spiegel, qui gère la division divertissement et sports chez PricewaterhouseCoopers (une grande entreprise d’audit et d’expertise comptable) :
« Il s’agira d’un tournant décisif, non seulement pour l’industrie du jeu vidéo, mais aussi pour tous les acteurs des secteurs des médias et du divertissement, qui devront faire face au fait qu’une partie de leur audience va délaisser leurs plateformes pour aller jouer à GTA 6 . »
Contrairement à l’industrie du jeu vidéo, celle du cinéma n’a pas pris de précautions particulières pour éviter GTA 6 puisque l’on note tout de même quelques sorties majeures, comme le prochain Hunger Games qui a réalisé de bonnes préventes. Malgré tout, un cadre d’une grande chaîne de cinéma reconnait que quiconque dans l’industrie qui joue un peu sait à quel point GTA 6 aura un impact , sans savoir dans quelle mesure.
Le week-end de lancement sera peut-être difficile, mais Geoff Keighley (producteur des Game Awards) a lui aussi son avis sur la question et pense que cela va s’étendre sur plusieurs semaines. Jusqu’à la sortie de Dune 3 et Avengers: Doomsday ? C’est bien possible, même si ces films sont forcément un peu à part du reste de l’industrie pour les personnes interrogées.
C’est surtout le milieu du streaming qui risque d’être impacté , comme le confie un représentant qui travaille sur une série qui sera bientôt diffusée (sans que l’on sache laquelle) :
Même l’industrie de la musique se prépare à un séisme , avec l’album du jeu qui devrait truster largement le haut des classements des plateformes de streaming. Le plus difficile sera surtout d’exister sur les réseaux sociaux. Cela pourrait impacter le marketing de ces films et de ces séries, étant donné que le jeu va occuper une grande place dans les discussions. Réponse dans quelques jours.

articles.t: GTA 6 : un DLC officiel gratuit révélé par une fuite pour le plus grand plaisir des joueurs
articles.chapeau: À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
articles.txt:
À quelques semaines de la sortie de GTA 6, une fuite Discord évoque une campagne Hexagon avec GTA 6 DLC gratuit et récompense mystère. Contenu, dates, enjeux : ce bonus soulève déjà bien des questions.
GTA 6 n’est même pas encore sorti et un premier « DLC » gratuit fait déjà parler de lui. Une fuite du code de Discord mentionne une campagne marketing baptisée « Hexagon » , centrée sur Grand Theft Auto VI , avec thème dédié et récompense mystérieuse à la clé.
Derrière ce nom de code se cacherait ce que certains médias décrivent déjà comme un premier GTA 6 DLC gratuit . Entre contenu cosmétique, éventuelle récompense in‑game et bonus de pré‑lancement, la communauté s’interroge sur ce que cette collaboration pourrait réellement offrir.
Le dataminer Wumpus Central a fouillé une version de test de Discord et repéré une campagne GTA 6 Discord nommée « Hexagon ». Dans les fichiers figurent une icône d’application GTA 6 , un app theme aux couleurs de Vice City et une police de pseudo inspirée de la typo officielle du jeu. Des sites comme RockstarINTEL ou GTA BOOM ont rapidement relayé l’information.
Plus intéressant pour les joueurs, le code mentionne une « quest with unknown reward » qui « may be coming soon during the campaign too », selon Wumpus Central sur X. GamingBible parle déjà de « first free in‑game reward » pour GTA 6 , d’où l’expression de contenu additionnel GTA 6 ou de « DLC gratuit ». Mais rien ne prouve encore que la récompense sera utilisable dans le jeu plutôt que limitée à Discord.
Les Discord Quest sont des campagnes où l’utilisateur doit accomplir une action pour décrocher une récompense : jouer à un jeu un certain temps, regarder un trailer ou participer à un événement. En 2022, par exemple, des quêtes liées à Fortnite Paradise permettaient de débloquer des objets in‑game, tandis que d’autres campagnes n’offraient que des cosmétiques Discord comme des décorations d’avatar.
Pour cette quête Discord GTA 6 , plusieurs scénarios sont plausibles : simple bonus Discord (thème exclusif, décorations de profil), skin d’arme ou tenue unique dans GTA 6 , voire petit avantage de pré‑commande lié au compte Rockstar Social Club. Dans tous les cas, il faudra très probablement accepter la Quest dans l’interface officielle, puis remplir l’objectif indiqué. Attention aux faux liens « GTA 6 Discord Hexagon » envoyés en message privé, terrain idéal pour le phishing .
D’après le datamine relayé par RockstarINTEL , la campagne Hexagon débuterait le 17 novembre 2026 à 18 h 00 UTC, soit 19 h en France, deux jours avant la sortie officielle de GTA 6 le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S . Les utilisateurs gratuits pourraient participer jusqu’au 8 décembre 2026, tandis que les abonnés Discord Nitro auraient jusqu’au 15 février 2027.
Ce possible bonus GTA 6 avant la sortie s’inscrirait dans une stratégie où Rockstar Games mise sur des collaborations et des freebies plutôt que sur des DLC solo payants dès le lancement. Officiellement, ni Rockstar ni Discord n’ont confirmé la campagne Hexagon, qui pourrait encore être modifiée ou annulée. Les joueurs en quête de GTA 6 DLC gratuit ont donc tout intérêt à surveiller les annonces officielles et l’onglet Quest de Discord à l’approche du 17 novembre.

articles.t: GTA 6 First Review Scores Appear Online Early
articles.chapeau: GTA VI is finally almost here, and it seems as though some impressions of the game have surfaced online early.
articles.txt:
By James Lynch Published Nov 11, 2026, 5:38 AM EST James is a gaming writer from London who has spent thousands of hours exploring titles from every genre. Though he has a particular affinity for multiplayer titles like World of Warcraft, Destiny 2 and League of Legends, he has also put thousands of hours into single-player experiences, from deep RPGs to epic PC strategies. When he's not playing or writing, he can usually be found supporting his beloved Brentford FC. Sign in to your ScreenRant account The wait for Grand Theft Auto VI has been a genuinely monumental one, with all the delays and speculation only making the time we've been standing by to play it feel even longer. That said, the game is finally almost here, and we're a little over a week out from the November 19 release date at the time of writing.
While we're all assuming that the years of effort that Rockstar have put into developing the game will pay dividends, and we're all going to be playing the standout game of recent times, we don't actually know that just yet. Until we get to try it for ourselves and work through the story and multiplayer modes (eventually), we can't really give the developer their flowers.
We shouldn't have long to wait until the embargo passes, and we can find out officially from those who have played it what their thoughts are, but before then, reviews have started to appear online and they are just as positive as you might expect.
Jason rides a motorcycle as he runs away from police in GTA 6. Over on Reddit , one user shared a post with a screenshot from the PlayStation store of GTA VI's official page. On it, there are now 11 reviews for the game in total, all of which are currently five stars. The interesting part of that is that the store on the platform usually requires players to have purchased and played a game in order to review it.
That leaves very few options for how this happened, with one being that those who were given early access have broken cover and added their feedback to the store's ecosystem. At the moment, these appear to just be ratings for the game, rather than written feedback of any time, but it could be a sign that the game is set to deliver on the scale that many are expecting.
Many weighed in with their own guesses at how good the finished game would be, with one saying , "Quite a bit of hate both valid and bs around the game, so a game on this scale will probably fluctuate a fair amount, unless I am underestimating the hype compared to the hate/idc for GTA but will rate it poorly crowd."
While another added that a perfect score may be impossible, saying , "Even if the game is good enough to warrant a 99, it may be impossible. OOT came out when much fewer journalists were about (it only has 22 reviews, RDR2 has 99), and all it takes is a couple giving a good-but-not-incredible score and you haven't got a 99."
In the end, the proverbial proof in the pudding will come when you have played Grand Theft Auto VI for yourself, and though reviews can act as an excellent guide to what to expect, a game as big as this one is going to generate all sorts of opinions. With just eight days to go until it releases to the masses, let's hope we're not in the timeline where it fails to hit the expectations of the audience.

articles.t: GTA 6 Pre-Order Poster vs Map: Map Wins at $79.99 [2026]
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 physical pre-order poster vs map compared: see what is confirmed at the $79.99 price point and why the map wins for collectors in 2026.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games says the free printable Grand Theft Auto VI cover-art poster and Leonida map go live on November 19, 2026, and a double-sided physical version will sell for $0.99 through the Rockstar Store, according to Vice . That announcement is the only part of this story with an official stamp on it. Everything about the GTA 6 physical pre-order poster showing up in boxed copies instead of a map rests on a retail leak that nobody has tied to a named store.
The leak, as reported, says some physical GTA 6 pre-orders may come with a poster where fans expected a folded map. No retailer, product SKU, pre-order price, release date or bonus list has been established by that report. Rockstar has not said that any poster or map ships inside retail packaging. So the headline is a live rumor with a confirmed backdrop, and this analysis keeps those two layers apart.
The timing matters because the game is close. Launch day is November 19, management reaffirmed that date on November 9–11, 2026 and said development was complete, and our earlier look at the rating still pending with eight content descriptors showed how many small details remain open this late. A poster-or-map question looks minor next to a 212 GB download, but collectors, retailers and Rockstar’s own store all have money riding on the answer.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the solid ground. According to Beebom , Rockstar published a Newswire post on November 3, 2026 that covers three separate items. The first is a printable cover-art poster. The second is a printable map of Leonida. The third is a double-sided physical poster that carries the cover art on one face and the full map on the other.
The two printable files arrive as free digital downloads on Rockstar’s official site on November 19, 2026. Vice reports that players do not need to pre-order or buy the game to grab them. The physical version follows later. Rockstar describes the timing as “shortly after launch,” a phrase Vice quotes directly, and no exact date has been announced.
Pricing is simple. The physical item costs $0.99 by itself, or it comes free with any purchase from the Rockstar Store. Press Start Australia headlined the same announcement as a map and poster that is free digitally at launch or sold for $1. Rounding aside, the outlets agree on the structure: free file, cheap paper copy, store-only sales channel.
Rockstar has also confirmed, per its own Newswire headline, that pre-loading began on November 10 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S versions. That detail sits next to the map news in the same wave of announcements, which tells us Rockstar is sequencing its final-stretch messaging deliberately. The company has been feeding fans a steady stream of material, from the 39-screenshot launch gallery to preload dates, and the poster plan fits that cadence.
Now the shaky ground. The reported retail leak suggests that the physical GTA 6 retail package includes either a poster or a map. It does not say which one, and it does not say at which store. Our verification notes flag all of the following as unconfirmed: the poster-versus-map choice, the retailer, the SKU, the pre-order price, the release date and any included bonus.
That is a long list of blanks. A real leak from a retailer’s backend usually carries at least one hard identifier, such as a product code or a listing price. When a story arrives without any of those, readers should treat it as a claim about what a listing might contain, not as a record of what a box contains.
One more constraint shapes how we cover it. Rockstar’s announcement does not confirm that the physical poster will ship with boxed game versions. Vice makes the same point plainly. It says the update does not explicitly address retailers and their own bonus items, and it describes the map as a separate release rather than a physical-edition pre-order bonus. Beebom reaches a similar reading, headlining its piece as a free physical map that is not for physical buyers.

À quelques jours du lancement de GTA 6, une datamine du préchargement PS5 Pro révèle un mode 120 Hz et un PSSR 13.60 inédit. Faut-il y voir le signe d’un futur mode 40 FPS très convoité ?
À quelques jours de la sortie console de Grand Theft Auto VI , fixée au 19 novembre 2026, un détail enfoui dans le préchargement PS5 agite la communauté. En fouillant ces fichiers mis en ligne dès le 10 novembre, le dataminer Tex2 , figure de GTAForums , a repéré un mode 120 Hz dédié à la PS5 Pro et une nouvelle version de la technologie d’upscaling PSSR de Sony .
Relayée par RockstarINTEL et la presse spécialisée, la fuite mentionne un module « MFSR / PSSR 13.60 » ainsi qu’une absence totale de tag VRR . Ce combo 120 Hz sans VRR correspond parfaitement à un mode 40 FPS , même si, officiellement, Rockstar ne promet toujours que 30 FPS sur consoles, avec un rendu interne probablement autour de 1440p upscalé en 4K. De quoi espérer une GTA 6 plus fluide sur PS5 Pro, sans aucune garantie pour l’instant.
Une datamine ne pirate pas le jeu, elle lit simplement les capacités que le moteur déclare à la console. Dans le build PS5 Pro de GTA 6 , Tex2 a repéré un flag « High Frame Rate 120 Hz » et un « High CPU Frequency Mode », ce qui confirme un profil distinct de la PS5. On y voit aussi un bloc PSSR en version 13.60, alors que de nombreux titres « PS5 Pro Enhanced » restent sur la branche 13.00A, et la build PS5 standard ne mentionne pas QSSR , l’upscaler des consoles non Pro.
Sur un téléviseur 120 Hz, un mode 40 FPS s’intègre bien, car 120 divisé par 40 donne trois rafraîchissements par image, avec un temps d’affichage moindre qu’à 30 FPS. Associé au PSSR 13.60, conçu pour approcher la 4K tout en calculant moins de pixels en interne, ce profil donne à la PS5 Pro un terrain pour viser un framerate plus élevé. Mais, comme l’a rappelé Rob Nelson , co-directeur de Rockstar North , cité par Notebookcheck, les développeurs « visent les 30 fps pour la date de sortie du 19 novembre », un monde ouvert comme Leonida restant très gourmand en processeur.
Passer de 30 à 40 FPS représenterait environ 33 % d’images en plus, une latence un peu plus faible et des mouvements plus naturels, à condition de disposer d’une TV 120 Hz HDMI 2.1 et d’activer le 120 Hz dans les réglages système de la console. Mais les métadonnées ne prouvent que ce que le moteur peut faire, pas ce que Rockstar Games exposera dans les options, et avec une PS5 Pro vendue autour de 899,99 € en France, beaucoup attendront la présentation officielle des modes graphiques et les premiers tests avant de décider si un 40 FPS justifie l’investissement.

articles.t: Bethesda denies The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel leak of news on Skyrim anniversary
articles.chapeau: Bethesda dismissed any chance of the Skyrim 15th Anniversary involving its sequel. On Reddit, the company poured cold water on rumors of a November 11th update. The studio recently asked gamers anxious for an Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date to be patient.
articles.txt:
Todd Howard finally announced the full name of the most anticipated Bethesda game. The studio head also cautioned fans not to expect more news soon, casting doubt on The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date . Still, rumors emerged teasing that the Skyrim 15th Anniversary could bring a surprise. Sadly, the publisher has now dismissed the possibility with a Reddit post .
Bethesda surprised readers by joining an Elder Scrolls 6 discussion focused on the Skyrim celebration. Its official account confirmed there would be no “big announcements” on November 11th. The company then stated it will “not be sharing anything new on Sentinel for some time.”
The comments match what the studio said after the November 3rd Bethesda 40th birthday update . Followers did gain a clue from the subtitle and video, which hinted at the game taking place in Hammerfell. Otherwise, none of the revelations suggested an Elder Scrolls 6 release date in the near future.
Despite evidence to the contrary, hopes were raised again ahead of Skyrim’s 15th Anniversary. Content creator King Fan Man is partly responsible, claiming a studio source told him of imminent news. Reece “Kiwi Talkz” Reilly then made a vaguer statement about a November 11th development. Even so, it was not necessarily related to the open-world RPG .
Waiting since 2011 for a sequel, desperate fans look for any reason to be optimistic. Xbox would also like to see progress with its popular franchises to boost sinking profits. The reality is that an Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel release date in 2027 or even 2028 has become unlikely.
Bloomberg insider Jason Schreier recently warned the Bethesda game wouldn’t surface for more than two years. He said he learned of a development timetable making 2029 a realistic target. Windows Central’s Jez Corden echoed that thinking in his own report.

articles.t: GTA 6 could get FSR 4.1 support on Xbox Series X|S to compete with PSSR on PS5 Pro
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 has been confirmed to get support for PSSR on the PS5 Pro, though the exact version is unclear. A new report has suggested that the game could come with some upscaling technology on the Xbox Series consoles as well.
articles.txt:
GTA 6 pre-loads have started, and sure enough, people are digging into the downloadable files. A recent PS5 datamine revealed the presence of PSSR, or PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution, in GTA 6 , and now a deep dive into the Xbox Series X/S files has revealed the presence of FSR, or FidelityFX Super Resolution.
PSSR is Sony’s AI-driven upscaling technology specifically designed for the PS5 Pro. The base PS5 also has a version of it called QSSR, or Quick Spectral Super Resolution. Following the datamine, Rockstar officially confirmed that PSSR will be available in GTA 6 , though the datamine suggested it would support a newer or different version of the upscaling technology.
Xbox, on the other hand, was recently added to the list of devices that will be getting FSR 4.1 support. While AMD did not confirm when that would be, some developers already have access to it, including older versions of the technology. It won’t be surprising if Rockstar is one of those developers, with early access to FSR 4.1, which increases the possibility of GTA 6 getting FSR 4.1 support sooner rather than later. That said, chances of the game getting FSR 4.1 at launch are slim, but at least it will come with some version of the upscaling tech at launch, as indicated by the Xbox Series package datamine.
It also makes sense that at some point in the future, GTA 6 would be updated to the latest version of FSR for Xbox Series console owners. As to how this would affect the game’s performance on Xbox consoles, remains to be seen.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 reviews already live on PlayStation Store before embargo and release date
articles.chapeau: Anxious players have managed to post GTA 6 review scores on the PlayStation Store. In some cases, PSN accounts can share ratings prior to release dates. Likely suspects are media members testing the PS5 game ahead of the November 18th embargo.
articles.txt:
The GTA 6 review embargo reportedly doesn’t end until November 18th, the day before the release date . Regardless, ratings are already appearing on the PlayStation Store. PS Store DB , which monitors the marketplace’s backend, discovered 11 entries producing a 5/5 score.
Dataminer Cokymoky later reported there are actually 12 ratings, averaging 4.67/5.0. 92 percent of users gave the PS5 game 5 stars, while one person believed it deserves a single star (now changed to 5/5). Sony started testing written reviews in August 2024, but Cokymoky69 hasn’t found any text on the PlayStation Store.
PSN accounts can judge a digital purchase without waiting for official launches. There are also no minimum playtime requirements. One explanation is that the mystery players are sites or YouTube channels that Rockstar sent codes to. While preloads have begun for buyers, actually booting the title may have unlocked their ability to register scores.
Microsoft is even more lax about its marketplace policies. Months ahead of the GTA 6 release date, ratings flooded the Xbox Store. Although it’s a questionable practice, anyone who pre-orders a game can share their opinion early. The Rockstar project currently boasts a perfect 5/5 after nearly 10,000 submissions.
The small sample of GTA 6 PS5 reviews on the PlayStation Store backend may not reflect the post-launch consensus. Nevertheless, if the activity is from journalists, they could preview Metacritic ratings .
Given the record-setting sales , fans have questioned whether the views of the media will matter. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick pushed back on that thinking in a May interview, saying critical reception remains important . He praised the quality of Rockstar’s work, noting past titles scored in the mid-to-high 90s.
Most PSN users with pre-orders must hold off until the GTA 6 release date for reviews. As with Xbox and PS5 preloads, New Zealand players will be the first to explore Leonida .
